The '''Korsin Museum''' held many artifacts of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s past. One of these artifacts was a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which had been taken as a trophy before the ''[[Omen]]'' crashed on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].
